basic_info.name: Cacophony (Cacophony: An Improved Contrastive Audio-Text Model)
basic_info.org: University of Rochester (Ge Zhu, Jordan Darefsky, Zhiyao Duan; Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering + Computer Science), supported by New York State Center of Excellence in Data Science and U. Rochester Goergen Institute for Data Science
basic_info.release_date: arXiv preprint Feb 2024 (2402.06986); published IEEE/ACM Transactions on Audio, Speech, and Language Processing (TASLP), vol. 32, pp. 4867-4879, Dec 2024 (DOI 10.1109/TASLP.2024.3485170)
basic_info.links: paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.06986 ; code: https://github.com/gzhu06/Cacophony ; checkpoints: Google Drive folder linked in repo README (AudioMAE.ckpt, Cacophony.ckpt); not on HF Hub [uncertain]

architecture.backbone: Audio encoder: AudioMAE-style spectrogram transformer (85.26M params, trained stage 1 with masked-autoencoder objective, decoder discarded). Text encoder: RoBERTa-architecture transformer with causal self-attention instead of bidirectional (to feed the decoder), initialized from RoBERTa pretrained weights (125.23M params). Text decoder: stacked causal transformer layers with cross-attention to audio encoder output (76.46M params, randomly initialized)
architecture.input_modality: audio + text (English captions and generated captions)
architecture.training_objective: Two-stage: Stage 1 masked-autoencoder (MAE) reconstruction on unlabeled audio; Stage 2 contrastive (InfoNCE, l2-normalized projected embeddings with learned linear projections and multi-head attention poolers over frame-level audio/token-level text embeddings) + auxiliary captioning objective (CoCa/BLIP-inspired, weight lambda_Cap=1); SAM optimization used
architecture.embedding_output: Global contrastive embeddings after multi-head attention pooling (dim not explicitly verified, output dim single per modality [uncertain]); framewise audio embeddings exist before pooling, so frame-level extraction is architecturally possible [uncertain]

data.training_data: Self-curated dataset of 3.9M text-audio pairs / 13,000 hours built by cleaning noisy captions with pretrained LLMs and auto-captioning unlabeled audio (includes WavCaps-style sources; AudioSet-derived pretraining data mentioned); Stage 1 trained on 15 s random samples, Stage 2 on 10.24 s audio (512 patches); dataset not officially released [uncertain]; license of data not stated [uncertain]

performance.benchmarks: Audio-text retrieval (embedding-family, standard suite): state-of-the-art or comparable at release on AudioCaps (better than WavCaps and LAION-CLAP models) and Clotho (comparable to WavCaps-CNN14); the non-feature-fusion FLAP model surpassed, fusion-based FLAP matched [uncertain exact R@k numbers]; competitive HEAR benchmark results; zero-shot classification; automated audio captioning via the decoder (BLEU/ROUGE/METEOR/CIDEr/SPICE/SPIDEr on AudioCaps/Clotho)
performance.vs_clap: Better audio-text retrieval than LAION-CLAP baselines and GLMs on AudioCaps at release (SOTA); exact numeric deltas vs LAION-CLAP not extracted [uncertain]

availability.license: Code and checkpoints released open (public GitHub + Google Drive checkpoints); explicit license text not verified [uncertain]; CAPTION training data private [uncertain]

fit_for_local_playlist.sample_rate: 16 kHz (AudioMAE convention); requires resampling from repo-standard 48k mono
fit_for_local_playlist.inference_cost: Audio encoder 85.26M alone; full audio-text model ~287M params total (85.26M audio + 125.23M text + 76.46M decoder, decoder unnecessary for retrieval); 10.24 s / clip; CPU inference is slow but feasible [uncertain], GPU recommended for library indexing
fit_for_local_playlist.full_track_context: Fixed ~10 s window (10.24 s, 512 patches, random patch sampling beyond that); no native long-track support — windowed inference with aggregation required
fit_for_local_playlist.frame_level_support: Architecturally yes — audio encoder produces framewise embeddings over spectrogram patches before the multi-head attention pooler; released code path for frame embeddings not verified [uncertain]
fit_for_local_playlist.retrieval_steering: No explicit attribute-control/steerability mechanism; standard prompt-based retrieval; captioning decoder enables caption-based exploration but not sparse attribute steering

uncertain: exact R@k retrieval numbers vs CLAP baselines
practical frame-level embedding extraction in the released code
